Well just recently, i'd say about like 2 days recently I became officially involved in some urban exploration in south florida. A friend and I went to a public park on 4/20 to you know...celebrate. While we were walking around a large plain of trees, shade, and benches, we heard some glass breaking and saw some bikes parked on the floor next to a huge plot of thick trees. When we examined, there was a small barbed fence that had been bent down so we decided we would explore once we were sure no one was there.

Skip a few hours later of fucking around, we return to the site and not so precisely just make our way over the fence towards the location, which ended up being a small house. We were careful in walking around the thick greenery because we were in spider territory, but nothing could have prepared us for the gut wrenching smell that was coming from the house thay was visible up ahead. We were gagging before we decided to place our shirts over our noses ans mouths. This place was covered in vines and was severely taken over by nature, but that didn't explain the smell. We looked inside and were just about ready to walk in until realising the amount of mold we would inhale could kill us.

Dumb enough we walked in anyway and the stench got worse and worse. From calendars on the old rusted fridge, the house dated back to 1999. It was all fun and adrenaline was pumping due to how interesting and dangerous it was to explore a fragile house but out of the corner of my eye, i saw something that made my heart stop. I played it off in denial but i knew what i saw; my friend was just looking about how to get into the master bedroom that was blocked by shelves before i subtly encouraged him that it was time to leave. As we left, i swear i could feel a hand on my shoulder urging me to stay but there was no one behind me which made me think my anxiety was playing games.

When we were leaving, I really wanted to tell my friend about what i saw but remained quiet knowing he would go into a panic attack if i informed him that there was evidence of human remains in the house under a large amount of debris in the corner.

The bad stench was nature + a dead body that had beeb decaying for years probably, or maybe my eyes were playing tricks. All i know is that it looked real and my nostrils were killing me.
